product.title: Mauna Kea Stargazing Experience + Photos

description.text: From Kona-accessible Big Island heights, join one of the world's premier stargazing locations with an astronomer and professional astrophotographer. See the night sky like never before through a Unistellar EV2 Telescope, and leave with stunning photos of your group with galaxies, stars, and constellations as the backdrop. Stops include Mauna Kea Access Road, Stargazing Site, Astrophotography Session. Transportation, equipment, and local commentary are handled so you can focus on Kona's coastline, volcanic highlands, coffee country, and island landmarks. Ideal for visitors basing in Kona who want a guided island experience without coordinating transport, gear, or park logistics on their own.
